title: Better Stacking
description: client configure item, entity, xp stacking
body:
# Better Stacking
**groups and displays entity for better preformance and utility**

without mod  
![without mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46cc1a686b0d1854421e416c63eeba2ab76de8e4_0.webp)

with mod  
![with mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9bcf0a19dc7a3826de2389139f120d747c4859ed_0.webp)


### Features:
- fully **client side**, only affects client visuals but not server calculations
- group **mobs**, **items** and **xp orbs** near each other
- display grouped entities' **name** and **count**
- **suffix** for big number, such as 2k or 6sb (shulker boxes)
- distinguish stacking between baby/ adult mobs/ custom name
- highly configurable
- optimised for preformance, rendering less entities for higher fps

### Configurations:
![Config screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77847abc797912498c1a2103776f4acbbde1f8aa.png)
- label size, colour, background
- Item stacking, item label
- Mob stacking, mob label
- xp stacking, xp label

### Dependencies:
- [fabric api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [modmenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- [cloth config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
